Ghi BR khop wiki material-request RULE (dung chu one, khong so 1):
BR-01: Each material request needs exactly one human approver / phe duyet.
BR-02: SKU on the request must match warehouse stock identity; no silent substitution.
BR-03: Negative stock is not allowed after pick.
BR-04: MSDS constraints block pick when missing.
BR-05: Warehouse clerk picks only approved requests.
